nodes.label: Support Pipeline Design
nodes.rationale: Agentic AI Challenge Iraq Topic 06. The product is a back-office batch pipeline, not a chatbot. Success is a live judge run, committed results for jev, gemini, and cascade, and the pre-scoring checks. Real customer data, real ZainCash integrations, sending messages, and cloud deployment are out of scope. Simple and reliable beats complex.

nodes.label: Cascade Classifier
nodes.rationale: Classification, extraction, routing, and escalation stay a fixed deterministic sequence. Jev runs first because it is calibrated and picks spans instead of generating them. Gemini self-consistency is the second opinion. If that is still uncertain, a person decides. A bounded tool-calling agent is used only for investigate-and-draft.

nodes.label: Bounded Drafting Agent
nodes.rationale: The agent is limited to six tool calls and 30 seconds and must finish by calling submit_draft. The ticket is wrapped as untrusted data. Tools only read data except flag_for_human and submit_draft, which record the agent's own output. Every call is stored on agent_trace.

nodes.label: Draft Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Citations must be chunks retrieved in this run. Amounts, references, dates, and phones in the draft must appear in the ticket or the matched transaction. The draft must not ask for an OTP, PIN, or password, checked by regex and a Jev requests_credentials noul below 0.2, and it must be Arabic of at most 120 words. A failed check keeps the draft and escalates with draft_failed_guardrail.

nodes.label: No Send Path
nodes.rationale: Results are saved as pending_review or escalated. There is no send path anywhere. Review actions write to reviews. An approved reply is available only through Copy approved reply.

nodes.label: Taxonomy Specification
nodes.rationale: data/taxonomy.yaml is the single source of truth for categories, teams, and priorities. Hard overrides: fraud_suspected above 0.5 sets P1, and money_lost above 0.5 sets priority to at least P2.

nodes.label: Synthetic Data and Held-Out Split
nodes.rationale: All data is synthetic. About 300 tickets are split 200 dev and 100 test with seed 42, and test.sha256 is committed before any tuning. Prompts and thresholds are tuned on dev only. Gemini both generates the tickets and judges drafts; that bias is disclosed and human ratings are the counterweight.

nodes.label: Weekly Pattern Report
nodes.rationale: Stretch goal kept in scope. An issue is rising when this week is at least 1.5 times last week, there are at least five tickets, and a Poisson test gives p < 0.05. Clusters of matched transactions are checked against service incidents, then a Jev noul and a Gemini narrative that must cite counts and ticket ids.

nodes.label: LangGraph Orchestration Decision
nodes.rationale: The fixed stages become a LangGraph StateGraph so routing stays plain Python and a batch uses graph.abatch with return_exceptions and RetryPolicy. This replaces the hand-written semaphore and retry loop in section 6.8. langchain-typesafe is used instead of the raw SDK and is wrapped behind the Classifier interface because the package is alpha.

nodes.label: OpenRouter Provider Migration
nodes.rationale: The direct Google endpoint was blocked on the development network, so classification and extraction moved to OpenRouter and google/gemini-3.8-flash through langchain-openrouter, still behind StructuredLLM. OPENROUTER_API_KEY replaces GOOGLE_API_KEY for those calls. Jev stays pinned to jev-1.13.0. Reported cost takes precedence over the $0.75 / $3.75 token fallback.

nodes.label: Schema and Lookup Deviations
nodes.rationale: ambiguous was added for several matching transactions and escalates as txn_ambiguous. date_mismatch escalates too. T_GEM is 0.66 rather than 0.67 so two of three agreeing samples pass, which was the intent of the original threshold. Jev priority is read from the most likely Score level because score is an expected value. Schema changes use create_all instead of Alembic because the data is synthetic and resettable.

nodes.label: Failure Handling
nodes.rationale: If Jev is down the run switches to Gemini-only and sets runs.degraded. If Gemini is down, Jev classification still completes and the draft is skipped with llm_unavailable. A span that is not in the text becomes null. Prompt injection is treated as untrusted data. multi_issue, a missing transaction, and an amount mismatch all escalate with a note and never ask for secrets.
